name: Venomancer: Spider Lord turns Beetle Form into the Spider Lord model (#355)
contract: Spider Lord (704264) 'Augments Beetle Form into a Spider Lord'. Beetle Form (803183) is SPELL_AURA_MOD_SHAPESHIFT form 53, whose SpellShapeshiftForm display is the beetle 110063; neither 704264 nor its helper 805139 carries a model effect. On live the Spider Lord is the blue cryptlord2 with purple armor, which the shipped client only has at full size (display 139094, duplicated as 139099-139101), shrunk to a quarter. The talented Beetle Form must show 139094 at object scale 0.25 while keeping the player's combat reach, and every other state the ordinary model at scale 1.

steps.label: CONTROL: untalented Beetle Form keeps the beetle model
DISCRIMINATING: learning Spider Lord in Beetle Form shows the Spider Lord
DISCRIMINATING: the Spider Lord is shrunk to a quarter
The shrunk Spider Lord keeps the player's melee reach
Leaving Beetle Form restores the character model
Leaving Beetle Form restores full size
DISCRIMINATING: shifting into Beetle Form with Spider Lord shows the Spider Lord
The reshifted Spider Lord is shrunk to a quarter
Losing Spider Lord in Beetle Form restores the beetle model
Losing Spider Lord restores full size
